behavioral_identity: A split replaces one parent episode and its aggregate cosine with two independently ranked source turns; unsplit parents and split children then compete in one skip-on-overflow 32,000-character pack.

leave_one_out.definition: A parent is beneficial when replacing only that parent by its two independently ranked turns changes the question from no exact evidence delivered to some exact evidence delivered.

question: Can a deterministic candidate/query statistic choose which parent episodes to split into source turns better than parent length alone?

surrogate_audit.accepted_primary_level_for_registration: paired per-question availability under a policy applied to every candidate at a matched split rate
residuals: source-turn boundaries are supplied by the corpus rather than discovered
the retained embedder is fixed, so transfer to another embedder is untested
splitting changes semantic localization and rendered granularity together
